chunks: Hamza ibn Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ja'far, ibn Muhammad ibn Zayd, ibn Ali, ibn al-Husayn, ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) narrated in Qum in the month of Rajab in the year 339 A.H., saying: Ali ibn Hasham informed us in the year 307 A.H., from his father, from Ali ibn Ma'bad, from al-Husayn ibn Khalid, from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him), from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Whoever wishes to board the Ship of Salvation, hold fast to the Reliable Grip, and cling to the Strong Rope of Allah, let him be a friend of Ali after me and be the enemy of his enemy, and let him follow the Guides from his progeny, for they are my Successors, my Trustees, and Allah's Proofs upon the creatures after me, and the masters of my nation and the leaders of the pious to Paradise. Their party is my party, and my party is the party of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, and their enemies' party is the party of Satan.
ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for boarding the Ship of Salvation according to Imam Ali (AS)?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the lineage of Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Rida, establishes the Wilayah of Imam Ali and his progeny as the 'ship of salvation' and the 'firmest handle' (Al-Urwa al-Wuthqa) for believers. It explicitly links allegiance to the Ahl al-Bayt with divine guidance, identifying them as the successors and proofs of God, while contrasting their party with the party of Satan, a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegesis of key Quranic verses.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 28-42 In the (Arabic) month of Rajab of the year 339 A.H. (950 A.D.) in Qum Hamza ibn Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Zayd ibn Ali ibn Al-Hussein ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (s) narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem quoted in the year 307 A.H. (918 A.D.) on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ali ibn Ma’bad, on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Khalid, on the authority of Abil Hassan Ali ibn Musa Al-Ridha (s), on the authority of his father (s), on the authority of his forefathers (s), on the authority of Ali (s) that God’s Prophet (s) said, “

Whoever likes to board the Ship of Salvation, grab the Reliable Grip and guard himself with God’s Strong Rope, should love Ali after me and be the enemy of Ali’s enemies. He should follow the Divine Leaders to Guidance who are from Ali’s progeny and accept them as his leaders, since they are my Successors; Trustees; and God’s Proofs for the creatures; Masters of the nation and the guiders to Paradise. Their party is my party, and the party of their enemies is the party of Satan.”
